newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa Cargo appoints new board member.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cargo appoints new board member.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG said it has appointed Stefan Lauer as board member in place of Rainer Butz with effect from January 1, 1997.
Lauer is currently strategic corporate development manager of parent company Deutsche Lufthansa AG, the cargo airline said.
Butz will become a full-time director of DHL International DHL.CN in Brussels from next January with responsibility for operations, partnerships and alliances.
The new Lufthansa Cargo board comprises chairman Wilhelm Althen, finance and commercial director Walter Gehl and Stefan Lauer. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
